messages:
jane_acme: Hi team — I applied a free-trial code from the portal (TRIAL30) on 2024-03-01, then later applied a promo via the admin API (SPRING50). After applying SPRING50 my trial credit disappeared and the account shows no trial balance. Account: acct_1234. Can someone confirm whether applying a second code should remove the trial grant?

tara_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact codes + timestamps and the API call you used? Also do you have any response payloads?

jane_acme: Sure — applied SPRING50 at ~1716002000 via the admin endpoint. Request I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/promos/apply 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_admin_***" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"account_id":"acct_1234","code":"SPRING50","source":"admin"}'
```
Response: `200 OK` body: `{ "applied": true, "replaced_code": "TRIAL30", "note": "exclusive flag set" }`

kevin_billing: Not expected for a trial grant to be deleted like that. Our intended rule is: trial grants are non-stackable but should remain as a ledger credit and a percent-off coupon should create a separate credit entry — not revoke an existing grant. I'll pull the txn: looks like ledger txn `txn_98765` at 1716002010 shows a reversal of the TRIAL30 credit.

promo-bot: Event: promo.apply acct=acct_1234 code=SPRING50 result=applied replaced=TRIAL30 flags=[exclusive]

tara_support: @maria_engineer can you confirm whether the promo-service should ever replace a trial grant? If not, this sounds like a bug where exclusive semantics were applied too broadly. :eyes:

maria_engineer: Looking now. We rolled out a change last week where any promo with the `exclusive` flag will mark prior promos as void to avoid double percent-offs. Unfortunately that logic didn't check promo `kind` and so it treated trial_grant (one-time credit) like a stackable coupon. Repro steps: call admin apply with a trial in place + exclusive coupon — current flow emits a replace event.

tara_support: Customer, we'll restore your trial credit and issue a correction immediately. Quick workaround while we fix: remove SPRING50 via the admin remove endpoint, then reapply TRIAL30. I'll do the restore and post txns here.

jane_acme: Thanks — I rely on the trial credit for some dev usage tomorrow, really appreciate the quick turnaround.

tara_support: Done — issued manual ledger correction txn_98766 to re-create TRIAL30 amount on acct_1234. You should see the credit in the portal within ~5 minutes. I also removed SPRING50 from the account so it won't block the trial.

maria_engineer: I'll open a bug: billing:promo-exclusive-applies-to-grants. Plan: change promo-service to ignore `exclusive` for promo_kind == "trial_grant", add unit tests, and add a reconciliation job to detect any accounts where a trial was voided by an exclusive coupon in the last 30 days. I'll target a PR today, ETA EOD.

kevin_billing: We'll run an audit across ledger for the last 30 days for any reversal pattern matching `replaced_code` field and notify affected customers before EOD.

jane_acme: :thumbsup: appreciate it all — ping me if you need anything else from my side.

tara_support: Assigned and escalated. Internal note: customer-facing fix applied, follow-up PR from @maria_engineer. Add label `billing` `promo` `high-priority`.
